rules.text: Q6. Gap sizing: size each swing so that a gap of 2x the implied overnight move (spot x IV / sqrt(252) x 2) loses at most 1% of the account ($88). The summed gap-loss estimate across all overnight holds stays at or under 2.5% ($220). Stops don't protect against gaps.

rules.name: Q7
rules.text: Q7. Weekends: total weekend-held premium at most 4% ($352). No new swing after 2:00 PM ET Friday.

rules.name: Q8
rules.text: Q8. Scheduled events (earnings, FOMC, CPI, jobs): don't hold through them unless the event is the catalyst. If it is, the trade is High tier at half size.

rules.name: Q9
rules.text: Q9. Extended hours (4:00-9:30 AM, 4:00-8:00 PM ET): shares/ETFs only, limit orders only. Risk to stop is at most 0.5% of the account ($44). Spread at most 0.3% of price. Max 1 extended-hours position. Flat or converted to a regular-hours stop by the next open.

rules.name: Q10
rules.text: Q10. Asia-session monitoring (7 PM-3 AM ET) is monitor-only: no orders are placed from Asia signals alone. A flag fires if ES/NQ moves 1.5% or more against an open swing, BTC moves 5% or more (crypto proxies), or the Nikkei or Hang Seng moves 2% or more. When a flag fires, plan to exit at the pre-ma

rules.name: Q11
rules.text: Q11. Correlation: swings count toward F1 (crypto) and F2 (index). At most 2 same-direction positions in one sector or theme. Net delta-dollars across the book at most 50% of the account ($4,400).

rules.name: Q12
rules.text: Q12. Swing exits: the WT trail and the -35% hard stop apply, plus an underlying-level stop (a daily close beyond the thesis level). Checked at every close and again pre-market.

rules.name: Q13
rules.text: Q13. W3/W4 caps apply to the whole book, gap losses included. A gap breach halts new entries the same way a regular breach does.

rules.name: Q14
rules.text: Q14. Every independent trade logs its thesis, entry, stop, E, score, and sleeve BEFORE entry. Setups without an Oracle backtest are capped at Medium size.

rules.name: Q15
rules.text: Q15. Real account: swings, extended hours, and independent trades are disabled on real money until each has 30 paper trades AND John approves it in his own words.

rules.name: Q16
rules.text: Q16. Review after 30 independent and 20 swing paper trades: P&L, max drawdown, and gap losses versus the estimates.

rules.name: WT1
rules.text: WT1. At entry, estimate E (max realistic gain %): expected move = spot x IV x sqrt(DTE/365). Target underlying = the nearer of the expected move and the next support/resistance in the trade direction. Reprice the option at that target (Black-Scholes, or delta+gamma), subtract theta over the planned

rules.name: WT2
rules.text: WT2. Skip any trade where E is smaller than the tier's initial stop distance (reward must be at least equal to risk).

rules.name: WT3
rules.text: WT3. The initial stop is -35% for High tier and -25% for Medium. It stays until the trail takes over, and stops only ever move up.

rules.name: WT4
rules.text: WT4. Ratchet floors, by peak gain G on the option mid: G>=+30% locks 0% (breakeven); +50% locks +25%; +100% locks +60%; +200% locks +140%; +400% locks +300%; +1000% locks +800%; above that, 80% of G.

rules.name: WT5
rules.text: WT5. Running trail: stop = max(WT4 floor, peak value x (1-d)), with d=25% under +100%, 20% from +100% to +400%, 15% above +400%. Once price reaches E, d tightens to 10%.

rules.name: WT6
rules.text: WT6. Fixed +50% target: High tier drops it, and the trail runs alone. Medium tier sells half at +50% (or at E if E is lower) and trails the rest. Exits trigger on the bid, confirmed on 2 consecutive checks at least 1 minute apart.

rules.name: WT7
rules.text: WT7. Time exits: close everything by 3:45 PM ET on expiration day. With DTE<=2, halve d. Exit if half the time to expiry has passed and G<+10%. No holding through earnings unless earnings is the catalyst and the trade is High tier.

rules.name: WT8
rules.text: WT8. Check marks at least every 5 minutes during market hours, and log every stop move.

rules.name: WC1
rules.text: WC1. rules.name: WC2
rules.text: WC2. High (70+): up to the W1 cap of $300, with a -35% stop and the trail only. Medium (50-69): at most $150, a -25% stop, and a partial at +50%. Low (<50) or spread >15%: skip, logged as no-trade.

rules.name: WC3
rules.text: WC3. Once the real account is unlocked (R1), every dollar figure scales to R2: High at most $75, Medium at most $40.

rules.name: KT1
rules.text: KT1. Entry rules don't change: maker-only, net edge at least 5c, never above 70c, and size within K1-K2.

rules.name: KT2
rules.text: KT2. Default is to hold to settlement. Selling early happens only under KT3-KT5.

rules.name: KT3
rules.text: KT3. Profit ratchet, by peak bid P versus entry price e: P>=e+15c sets a floor at e+5c; P>=e+30c sets a floor at e+20c; P>=90c sets a floor at 80c. If the bid falls to the floor, exit.

rules.name: KT4
rules.text: KT4. Loss cut: exit if the model fair value drops below e-10c with at least 4 minutes left. Otherwise hold, because the max loss is already capped at cost.

rules.name: KT5
rules.text: KT5. In the last 2 minutes, a floor exit happens only if the model fair value is below 90c. Otherwise hold to settlement.

rules.name: KT6
rules.text: KT6. Exits are posted as maker asks at the floor. A taker exit (crossing the spread) would be a NEW permission that loosens K7, so it's not allowed unless John approves this line. For now, if a maker exit isn't filled within 60 seconds, hold to settlement.

rules.name: KC1
rules.text: KC1. Conviction score, 0-100: net edge 30 (>=10c full, 5-10c half); time left 20 (5-12 min full); book 20 (spread <=2c full, 3-4c half); how far the strike sits from spot relative to realized vol 15; spot momentum agreeing with the side 15.

rules.name: KC2
rules.text: KC2. High (70+): normal size (the $1 + $1-per-$100 rule, capped by K1). Medium (50-69): half size. Low (<50): skip, logged in notrade.

rules.name: X1
rules.text: X1. These rules build in paper logic now, labeled DRAFT, and they don't touch real money.

rules.name: X2
rules.text: X2. No tier or trail rule can raise size or loosen a stop past an approved or proposed limit. If there's a conflict, the stricter rule wins.

rules.name: X3
rules.text: X3. After 20 paper trades per bot, I'll report trail versus fixed-target results to John before anything becomes final.

rules.name: KW1
rules.text: KW1. Scope: maker-only buys at exactly 99c. Highs: locked or unlocked. Lows: only when the outcome is ASOS-locked with a margin of at least 1F. Never post below 99c. Hard block on any order against a locked side.

rules.name: KW2
rules.text: KW2. Per contract the max loss is $0.99 (maker fee 0). Normal size is 1 contract per market, the existing $1-at-risk rule.

rules.name: KW3
rules.text: KW3. Locked size-up cap: 3 contracts per market ($2.97, 3.2%). Unlocked highs stay at 1 contract and get pulled in the last 15 min.

rules.name: KW4
rules.text: KW4. Per event (a city-day across all strikes): at most 4 contracts ($3.96, within K1's 5%).

rules.name: KW5
rules.text: KW5. Weather share: at most 10% of bankroll ($9.36) in open weather cost. Weather and crypto combined stay within K2 (15%, $14.03, at most 3 open positions).

rules.name: KW6
rules.text: KW6. Daily cap: weather losses count toward K4 (10% of the start-of-day bankroll) and toward the circuit breaker.

rules.name: KW7
rules.text: KW7. Kill rule: any weather event loss stops weather trading immediately and logs it, and weather stays off until I review the loss and Hive Mind relays John's go-ahead.

rules.name: KW8
rules.text: KW8. Data guard: only ASOS readings at least 10 min old count. If the latest reading is more than 90 min old or the feed is down, treat the market as unlocked (lows skipped, highs 1 contract).

rules.name: KW9
rules.text: KW9. Log for every quote and fill: lock state and margin, queue position and depth, fill time, and settlement.
